The '''Appropriations and Disbursements Committee''' was a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senatorial]] committee in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] Senate. After the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the Appropriations and Disbursements Committee was given the power to control government spending by the [[Emergency Powers Act (Galactic Alliance)|Emergency Powers Act]].
